page.overview:
Who is Bundt?

Bundt is a giant, living wedding cake and a boss in Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars.

Bundt was made by Chef Torte for Booster and Peach at their wedding. Chef Torte goes to the wedding with the cake and sees Mario. He goes over to attack, but the cake begins to move. This cake is actually a monster and attacks Mario.

In battle, Bundt mainly attacks by ramming at Mario and company. Bundt can only be defeated by blowing out all five candles off its head. In doing so, Bundt weakens down to the even stronger Raspberry.

Bundt is named after a despite not being one.
